facts.value: Français économique (A-B-C-D)
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: There are a total of 4 different courses Français économique (A-B-C-D) as part of the elective modules in economic French. Each semester, one course is offered in rotation.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The elective modules all have the same level of difficulty (Target Level C1.1 according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages [CEFR]).
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The fee-based course Economic French 3 'Advanced' is very suitable as preparation for the elective modules.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Provisional admission for the qualification section of the Bachelor's examination according to PO §9 paragraph 5.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: There is a two-stage registration procedure with different deadlines. You must participate in both stages and pass the online qualifying test!
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Stage 1: Registration period: September 21, 2026 – October 5, 2026 via QIS.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Stage 2: Examination registration and deregistration deadlines: October 8, 2026 – October 21, 2026 via QIS. More info: see LSF.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The successful completion of a qualifying test at CEFR Level B 2.2, which takes place at the beginning of each semester if no Bachelor's elective module course in economic French has been successfully completed.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Exceptions: Students holding a Baccalauréat, Abibac or DALF / DELF C1 must upload this language certificate in PDF format during the Online Qualifying Test French on September 28, 2026 from 12:00 PM to 2:00 PM.
